pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Individual dark regions are primarily rhomboid and polygonal with smooth pixel-gradient edges. Patches occupy a high relative spatial area with consistent density across the visible flank and lower neck.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous network of light-colored interstitial pathways. Junction nodes primarily consist of three-way and four-way intersections. Pixel thickness of the corridors remains narrow and relatively uniform throughout the observed region.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: High-frequency, low-amplitude serrated silhouette along the dorsal neck mane, creating a finely jagged 1D contour against the background.
